policy: Included release-line and tag refs are bundled only when their tips are ancestors of release HEAD. preserveUnique refs are explicitly reviewed development lines pinned to immutable commit OIDs whose authentic commits remain relevant even outside HEAD. Exact non-source refs may be omitted only through an OID-pinned reviewed exclusion. Pattern-excluded agent and dependency branches must already be merged into HEAD; unique commits block packaging until individually dispositioned. Any other branch is omitted only when fully merged into HEAD; an unclassified branch with unique commits makes packaging fail.
